description:
The Analysis Solutions Business Area at Leidos is seeking Software Developers at multiple experience levels to support a government customer in Reston, VA. Candidates will join a fast-paced, mission-focused team of government and contractor personnel developing innovative software and data-driven solutions. Successful candidates will bring strong technical skills, creativity, attention to detail, and the ability to solve complex problems in dynamic environments.
 
 This position is onsite in Reston, VA and requires an active TS/SCI with Polygraph for consideration.
 
 Basic Qualifications by level -
 
 Mid-Level Software Development Engineer
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Systems Engineering, or related field with 4+ years of experience (or Master’s with 2+ years)

 2+ years supporting Intelligence Community or DoD environments

 Experience with software development using Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript

 Experience with full-stack development, including modern front-end frameworks (React/Angular) and backend services/APIs

 Familiarity with SQL/NoSQL databases, ETL pipelines, and Docker/containerized environments

 Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and DevOps practices

 Experience integrating AI/ML or LLM-based capabilities is a plus

 
 Senior Software Development Engineer
 Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years of experience (or Master’s with 6+ years)

 3+ years supporting Intelligence Community or DoD missions

 Advanced experience in software architecture, system design, and scalable application development

 Strong background in data pipelines, ETL workflows, APIs, and cloud-native/containerized systems

 Experience developing analytic, simulation, or scenario-based applications

 Experience integrating AI/ML, LLMs, or RAG-based solutions into production systems

 Ability to lead development efforts and mentor junior engineers

 
 Principal Software Development Engineer / Technical Lead
 Bachelor’s degree with 12+ years of experience (or Master’s with 10+ years)

 3+ years supporting Intelligence Community or DoD missions

 Deep expertise in full-stack development, system architecture, and cloud-based platforms

 Experience designing complex analytic systems, simulation platforms, and large-scale data pipelines

 Strong background in AI/ML, LLM integration, and advanced analytics

 Proven ability to lead technical strategy, prototype innovative solutions, and guide engineering teams

 Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills

 
 For All Levels - Key Responsibilities
 Design, develop, and maintain mission-focused software applications and data platforms

 Build and support ETL pipelines, APIs, and data integration workflows

 Develop web-based tools for analysis, visualization, and decision support

 Integrate AI/ML and advanced analytics capabilities into applications

 Collaborate with users and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions

 Support testing, debugging, optimization, and deployment activities

 Contribute to technical direction, documentation, and engineering best practices

 
 For All Levels - Preferred Skills
 Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities

 Experience working in Linux/Unix and Dockerized environments

 Familiarity with AWS cloud services and DevOps methodologies

 Ability to work independently and collaboratively in fast-paced mission environments

 Strong written and verbal communication skills

 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
 
 
 Original Posting: 
May 6, 2026 
 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.







 
 
 Pay Range: 
Pay Range $87,100.00 - $157,450.00 
 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
